issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires that a helper function named `print_logic`, if created, must NOT be globally visible (exported). The template repository, however, declares `global print_logic` and also provides a `print_logic` symbol/label. The solution repository does not export or define `print_logic`. This mismatch will confuse students: they are told not to export `print_logic` but the starter code already exports it, and the reference solution omits it. Students may be uncertain whether to remove or keep the symbol, or whether an exported helper is acceptable for automated checks.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the unintended export of the helper from the template: delete the line `global print_logic` from template_repository/helloWorld.asm (and/or remove the unused `print_logic` label if not needed). Ensure the template matches the problem statement and solution by not exporting `print_logic` so students are not misled about visibility requirements.
